cities.name: Nairobi
cities.blocker: Anonymous polygon geometry is available at zooms 16–19, but the public viewport and point-identify responses contain no native ID or attributes. The viewer’s app gates parcel/plan details to Gold/Platinum/Admin; no paid or organisation key route was used.
cities.nextStep: Use the published anonymous endpoint only for geometry-only display with provider provenance. For parcel/plan joins, wait for a government-published service or another public endpoint that returns stable IDs without paid/authenticated access.

cities.name: Dar es Salaam
cities.blocker: A public partial parcel candidate exists, but its extent lies about 28.7 km from the WUP point, a 1 km centre count is zero, and the item does not document Dar-city affiliation. No city-centre parcel geometry or authoritative registry endpoint was found.
cities.nextStep: Ask the publishing agency or data custodian for the service scope/authority and a published endpoint whose extent includes the WUP point or documented Dar municipality; then make a bounded parcel-ID+geometry query.

cities.name: Antananarivo
cities.blocker: Fresh OITF WFS checks reproduce three geometry-only PLOF polygons and a zero-feature city-centre bbox. DescribeFeatureType exposes only msGeometry; no feature ID or parcel attributes are present. PLOF is a land-status/planning inventory, not a verified cadastre.
cities.nextStep: Do not classify the PLOF layers as cadastral parcels. Ask OITF or the land administration for layer definitions/metadata, native IDs, coverage boundary, and any separate cadastral service; only reconsider after a bounded feature returns parcel semantics and stable IDs.
